relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Close friend; he understands her desire to learn from Kiriko and wishes her success.

periods.summary: At the post-tournament party, Nagi notices Shizuku's unease and talks with her about her desire to study under Kiriko after failing to help Ikki during his near death. When Shizuku asks whether he can accompany her to Hiroshima, Nagi apologizes because he wants to use summer break to return home and visit the grave of a friend he has neglected.

key_events.summary: Supports Shizuku emotionally and reveals his own summer plan.
